tools.name: hookr_release
tools.title: Hookr contracts
tools.description: The Hookr release the site trades on: whether it is verified on Robinhood Chain (4663), the block it was read at, its contract addresses by role, and the arb recapture lane. New pools bind another core and new tokens another launcher, under newPools. A hook of your own deploys on ownHookFactory (HookrOwnedRootFactoryV2), not on the release's rootFactory.

contracts.description: The release's contract addresses by role. rootFactory is the release's HookrRootFactory.

newPools.description: Where new pools and new tokens bind instead of the roles above.

ownHookFactory.description: Where a hook of your own deploys (HookrOwnedRootFactoryV2).

hookrBps.description: Hookr's cut of each arb recapture's profit by the Rules a pool binds.

core.description: Hookr's cut on pools that bind the core (newPools.rules), in bps.

other.description: Hookr's cut on pools on any other Rules, in bps.

tools.name: hookr_build_swap
tools.title: Build a swap
tools.description: Builds an exact-input swap through Hookr's router as an unsigned call for the wallet to sign and send, with its least output from the quote and your slippage, a 20-minute deadline and the gas to send it with, after checking the wallet's balance and simulating the swap from the wallet. Its status is ok (send the call), needs_approval (send the approval, then build again), or refused or unknown (no calls, with the reason). Every quote states priceImpactBps, null when it did not read; at or past 15% or on a token that is not the official one for its symbol the answer is refused, and an unread impact is unknown, never ok. accept names what to pass to build it anyway.

poolId.description: The pool's 32-byte Uniswap v4 PoolId, 0x and 64 hex characters.

side.description: buy pays the pool's quote currency (ETH, HOOKR, …) for the token; sell pays the token for the quote currency.

amount.description: How much the trade pays in, in the paying currency's own units as a decimal string, e.g. "0.05".

wallet.description: The wallet that signs and pays.

slippageBps.description: How far below the quote the output may land, in basis points (default 50).

recipient.description: Where the output goes. Defaults to the wallet.

acceptImpactBps.description: The most price impact you accept, in basis points, as a second tap on the swap box. Needed at or past 1500; an impact that did not read takes 10000.

acceptToken.description: The address of a look-alike token you mean to trade, one that is not the official token for its symbol.

status.description: ok, needs_approval, refused or unknown. refused and unknown carry no calls.

priceImpactBps.description: How far the trade moves the pool's price, in basis points, by the swap box's sum. null when it did not read, which is never no impact.

priceImpact.description: That figure in words: a percent, or Not read.

poolHoldsQuote.description: false when the pool has no quote currency to pay a seller; null when that did not say.

note.description: What the trade should know: its loss to price impact, or a pool with nothing to pay a seller.

calls.description: Unsigned calls, in the order to send them.

reason.description: Why the answer is not ok, in words an agent can act on.

accept.description: What to pass to build this trade anyway.

poolId.description: The pool's 32-byte Uniswap v4 PoolId, 0x and 64 hex characters.

tools.name: hookr_build_launch
tools.title: Build a token launch
tools.description: Builds a new token's launch as hookr.fun's Launch button does: one pool on ETH or a reviewed quote (HOOKR, USDG and the rest of the list) with the site's default Hook Blocks and arb recapture, holding the whole supply from the opening price up, so the wallet seeds no quote: buyers bring it. Checked and simulated from the wallet, it returns ok with the launch call (and any notes to show the creator before they sign), needs_approval with an approval to send first and build again with the same salt, or refused or unknown with the reasons and no calls.

wallet.description: The wallet that signs, pays and creates the token.

name.description: The token's name, at most 48 bytes.

symbol.description: The token's ticker, at most 12 bytes.

supply.description: The token's supply in whole tokens (default 1000000000).

logoURI.description: The token's logo, written into the token for good: an ipfs:// address or an https:// image link, at most 300 bytes. Hookr checks it is an image before it builds the launch.

quote.description: What the pool trades the token against (default ETH): ETH, or a reviewed quote by its symbol or address: WETH, USDG, HOOKR, WTH, NOVAAI, PONS, USDe, CASHCAT, UP, syrupUSDG, AI, BUN, ORBIO, BONER, CHUMP, SIF, U, HOODCHAN, MEME, Index, PIPEDOG, STATICS.

price.description: The opening price: how much of the quote one whole token costs, such as 0.000001 (default: the price that gives the token a $20,000 market cap at the quote's USD price, as hookr.fun's Create sets it).

lower.description: The range's lower price, in the quote per token, set with upper or in place of both as fullRange; with neither, the pool holds the token alone from the opening price up.

upper.description: The range's upper price, in the quote per token.

fullRange.description: Seed every price the pool can hold, in place of lower and upper: a full range takes both sides, so pass quoteSeed too. Without it or a range, the pool holds the token alone from the opening price up.

tokenSeed.description: Whole tokens the pool is seeded with, at most the supply (default: the whole supply); the wallet keeps the rest.

quoteSeed.description: How much of the quote the wallet seeds the pool with, none by default: buyers bring it. It needs a range: lower and upper, or fullRange.

salt.description: The salt that fixes the token's address. Pass back the salt a build returned to keep the same token.

blocks.description: Hook Blocks to add at their defaults, comma-separated, by the ids hookr_blocks gives.

kingOfThePool.description: Turn King of the Pool on, inside arb recapture. Needs lp-rewards or auto-burn in blocks.

arbRecapture.description: Put arb recapture on the pool (default true): the arbitrage profit between this pool and the token's other markets then goes to its LPs, What The Hook and Hookr instead of outside bots. A pool launched without it never gets it.

agentGateMinScore.description: Agent gate, Score to enter: the reputation score from the pool's reviewer that buys and adds need (default 0, none). Needs agent-gate in blocks and a reviewer.

agentGateTierScore.description: Agent gate, Score for the base fee: agents scored at or above it pay the base fee, the rest pay the surcharge. Set it with agentGateTierPips, or neither.

agentGateTierPips.description: Agent gate, Fee tier surcharge, in pips (10000 is 1%): paid to the pool's LPs by agents below the base-fee score or with no score. At most 50000.

agentGateMinAge.description: Agent gate, Age to enter: the seconds a wallet's link on the gate must have stood before it buys or adds, up to 30 days (one hour unless set, 0 for none). Needs agent-gate in blocks.

agentGateReviewer.description: Agent gate, Reviewer: priors for Priors, whose scores are whole numbers, or a reviewer set id registered on the gate. Needed with a Score to enter or a fee tier, and refused without one.

agentGateChecks.description: Agent gate, Checks: recipient (a buyer's recipient must be an agent too; the default), uniswapRouter (swaps through the Uniswap router are let in, checked on the wallet that sent them), recipient,uniswapRouter for both, or none. Needs agent-gate in blocks.

integrator.description: Builder credit: the account the pool names as its integrator, which earns the rate the treasury lists it at, up to half of Hookr's share of the pool's fees. It must be on the treasury's integrator list, and the pool freezes the rate when it opens.

integratorBps.description: The rate you expect the treasury lists the integrator at, in bps of Hookr's share (at most 5,000, which is 50%); the launch is refused if the list says otherwise. Needs integrator.

status.description: ok, needs_approval with the approvals to send first, refused or unknown.

calls.description: Unsigned calls, in the order to send them.

reason.description: Why the answer is not ok, in words an agent can act on.

tools.name: hookr_hook

tools.description: What kind of hook an address is on Robinhood Chain: Hookr's shared root, an own hook someone deployed through Hookr's factory (its owner, opening, the Hook Blocks it allows, whether arb recapture is on), or neither, with its listed pools. An own hook is a Hookr root too.

Name an agents-only pool for whether the wallet can buy, sell or add there, the surcharge it pays, the pool's terms (Score to enter, Score for the base fee, Fee tier surcharge, Reviewer, Age to enter, Checks) and the next step; it reads the gate the pool names.

linkAgeSeconds.description: How long the wallet's link has stood, in seconds.

Where that gate asks a wallet with code for a proof, pass proof to build linkWithProof, or sign the digest returned with a refused status as a message (a Safe) and send link; with unlink it builds the call that removes the link, and its status is ok (send the call), or refused or unknown (no calls, with the reason).

proof.description: For a wallet with code: the signature its isValidSignature approves for the link digest. Builds linkWithProof.

status.description: ok, refused or unknown.

It returns ok with the mint call and its gas (a native ETH leg goes as the call's value, and what the pool does not take comes back in the same transaction), needs_approval with the Permit2 approvals to send first and then build again, or refused or unknown with the reason and no calls.
